title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Casebook: Inconvenience Allowance after Gate Lockout or Tow Notices
content:
**Ruling.** An inconvenience allowance is added to a billing-error correction credit on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement: $25.00 where a notice of intent to tow was sent on the agreement in the last two months; $10.00 where no such notice was sent in that time but a gate lockout notice was; nothing in every other case. The allowance is added to the credit, and the credit as a whole is rounded to the cent.

A window of the last two months covers notices dated less than two whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month; a notice is placed in the window by its notice date.

### Cases (hypothetical)

**Case 1.** Handling date 20 May. A gate lockout notice dated 2 April and a notice of intent to tow dated 15 April. Both are inside the window (after 20 March). *Held:* $25.00; the tow notice governs where both were sent.

**Case 2.** Handling date 20 May. A gate lockout notice dated 25 March, no tow notice. *Held:* $10.00.

**Case 3.** Handling date 20 May. A notice of intent to tow dated 20 March. Exactly two whole months before the handling date is not less than two months, so the notice is outside the window; with no gate lockout notice in the window, *held:* nothing added.

**Case 4.** No gate lockout and no tow notice in the agreement's notice history. *Held:* nothing added.

| Notice of intent to tow in last two months | Gate lockout notice in last two months | Allowance added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | $25.00 |
| No | Yes | $10.00 |
| No | No | nothing |
